subject: Staggered close playbook: MSA/DPA/order form dependency heatmap
messages:
From: Taylor Reed <taylor.reed@aurorahealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.khan@aurorahealth.com>, Elena Vargas <elena.vargas@aurorahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kicking off close plan — MSA/DPA/order form dependencies

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Procurement and Legal asked that we put a concise close plan together that makes dependencies and gating criteria explicit — specifically when Aurora will need (1) an executed MSA, (2) a DPA covering PHI/PCI scoping, and (3) the initial order form and billing start date.

High level ask: can Redwood produce a short staggered-close playbook that maps out which artifacts must be in place to enable provisioning vs. billing vs. pilot evaluation? Our CFO wants clear cutover dates for finance and our security team needs the exact SOC2/SCC artifact list before we sign.

Attached: procurement questionnaire; happy to take a template MAP and adapt.

Next steps: can you share a proposed dependency heatmap and a suggested MAP by next Thu (Oct 8)? Also include expected DocuSign cadence if we need phased signatures.

Thanks,
Taylor
Taylor Reed
Sr. Procurement Manager, Aurora Health
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Taylor Reed <taylor.reed@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kicking off close plan — MSA/DPA/order form dependencies

Hi Taylor — appreciate the clarity. Attached is a first-pass staggered close playbook and a dependency heatmap that separates gating items for (A) provisioning/pilot access, (B) billed production, and (C) long-term compliance deliverables.

Key summary:
- Provisioning/pilot (Goal: sign-off in 2 weeks): requires countersigned Order Form with minimal SOW + acceptance of our standard DPA (no PHI in pilot) and an approved IP/data usage appendix.
- Billed production (Goal: +30 days after provisioning): requires fully executed MSA + DPA (PHI scoping if applicable), SOC2 evidence (type II summary), and completed billing contact form.
- Compliance artifacts (ongoing): full SOC2 report, encryption/KMS attestation, and retention/audit log SLA — these can be provided within 45 days of MSA execution in most cases.

I called out conditional paths in the heatmap: if Aurora requires PHI at pilot, we must push the pilot provisioning until the DPA is signed and a limited-access CIDR is in place. Otherwise we can provision with standard controls.

Proposed MAP (short):
1) Discovery sign-off (Aurora) — 3 days
2) Order Form sign (phase 1 pilot) — Redwood sends draft + DocuSign link
3) DPA review (Aurora legal) — redlines returned; target 5 business days
4) MSA redline roundtrip — target 10 business days for standard changes; escalation path to Monica/Ben if beyond 7 days
5) Provisioning & pilot kickoff — post signed order form + agreed DPA terms
6) Production go-live + billing start — post executed MSA + SOC2 evidence

I've also attached a plain-text checklist clients can use; let me know which items Aurora wants to compress or split.

Best,
Logan Wright
Director, Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
Attachments: OrderForm_Phased-Workflows.pdf
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: Aurora playbook — legal review & escalation plan

Team — quick internal to align before we send final to Aurora.

Notes:
- MSA redline: legal will likely push on liability cap and data-processing subclauses. I recommend we pre-fill a limited set of concessions (e.g., mutual cap increase to $X for enterprise accounts) to accelerate rounds.
- DPA: Priya, can you confirm whether our standard DPA covers the PHI scoping Aurora requested? If not, prepare a minimal PHI addendum and list of technical controls we can assert within 5 business days.
- SOC2 evidence: provide SOC2 type II summary + letter from compliance; attach an anonymized report excerpt, not full report. Ben, can you prepare the compliance bundle and redact internal client names?
- DocuSign strategy: prefer phased Order Form signature first (pilot) then MSA/DPA countersigned within 30 days. Helps cashflow but must be approved by finance.

Escalation: if legal roundtrips exceed 12 business days, escalate to VP Legal. If billing start slips beyond 45 days, finance will require a PO and an interim credit hold policy.

Thanks — Monica.

Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@aurorahealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, Taylor Reed <taylor.reed@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Elena Vargas <elena.vargas@aurorahealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Aurora redlines on DPA + clarification on pilot PHI

Logan / Monica — attaching our redline on the DPA and a short note on pilot PHI requirements.

Quick summary:
- We can accept a phased approach but any pilot handling PHI requires: (1) a signed DPA with explicit PHI addendum, (2) restricted network egress, and (3) audit log retention of 12 months.
- If Redwood is unable to meet (2) and (3) at pilot, Aurora will scope the pilot to synthetic data and proceed under the standard DPA.

Attached: Aurora_DPA_redline_20261006.docx

Samir Khan
Senior Counsel, Aurora Health
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Taylor Reed <taylor.reed@aurorahealth.com>, Samir Khan <samir.khan@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Vargas <elena.vargas@aurorahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 08 Oct 2026 15:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Staggered close playbook: next steps and DocuSign link for phase 1

Team — thanks for the redlines, Samir. We reviewed offline and prepared a short compromise DPA addendum that covers the PHI scoping required for a locked-down pilot (attached as MSA_redline_v3.docx for your legal to review).

Proposed next steps (confirmed):
- Today: Redwood sends Phase 1 Order Form via DocuSign (pilot-only, synthetic data by default). Link: https://app.docusign.com/transactions/abcdef-aurora-2241
- Within 5 business days: Aurora legal to confirm DPA redline acceptance or provide counter-redline.
- Target provisioning: once Phase 1 Order Form countersigned + DPA in agreed state (pilot cutoff).
- Production schedule: target production billing start 30 days after MSA execution; if PHI is required for prod, we need the PHI addendum signed and a network CIDR white-listing completed prior to provisioning.

I also attached a one-page heatmap that visually shows the conditional gating (provisioning vs billing). If Aurora agrees to the phased DocuSign approach, the pilot can start within 48 hours of the signed order form (assuming synthetic data).

If everyone agrees, Ben will trigger the DocuSign envelope and Priya will coordinate the SOC2 artifact bundle for legal review. Monica will be the escalation contact for any redline stalls.

Best,
Logan Wright
Director, Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
Attachments: MSA_redline_v3.docx; Aurora_Security_Questionnaire_v2.xlsx
